{"metadata":{"description":"DSH 文档阅读模式","id":"gh:1328031168","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-101","slug":"bill9109/dsh-101","topics":["dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"# dsh-101 — A document-first reader profile bundle for DSH"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"**Install:** `bash <(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bill9109/dsh-101/main/scripts/inst"},{"id":"p2s2","text":"all.sh) github:bill9109/dsh-101#v0.1.7`"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**DSH 101 is a document-first reading interface built on top of `dsh-base` + `dsh-web-app`: it organ"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"izes DSH's own documentation into an ordered, searchable, translatable reader.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Why this exists"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"DSH ships a large body of built-in documentation, but in its raw form it is a file dump: scattered a"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"cross the source tree, with no order, no search, and no comfortable way to read it. dsh-101 makes th"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"at documentation a first-class part of the DSH experience — a curated, ordered, searchable, translat"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"able reader instead of raw files, with the conversation panel alongside so you can ask questions whi"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"instead of raw files, with the conversation panel alongside so you can ask questions while you read."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- DSH's built-in documentation, curated and ordered by topic
- Built-in document translation
- A sli"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ding hidden table of contents
- Conversation panel on the right"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Boot the profile (default port 3081, coexists with the web GUI on 3080):"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Open http://127.0.0.1:3081 (or the port you chose): the reader shows the curated corpus with the sli"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ding table of contents, search filters the documents, translation switches the reading language, and"},{"id":"p12s3","text":" the right-hand panel is the DSH conversation you already know."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"This repository ships both a **bundle** (`@bill9109/dsh-101`, installable via `dsh plugin add`) and "},{"id":"p14s2","text":"a
**`profile/` directory** (a ready-to-use `dsh-101` profile composing `dsh-base` + `dsh-web-app` +
"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"this bundle). DSH's official distribution model is "distribute bundles, compose profiles" — there is"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"
no official command to distribute a profile, but a profile is just a directory under
`$DSH_HOME/pro"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"files/<name>/`, so the repository's `profile/` is directly usable."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"**Recommended: one-liner script** (places `profile/` into `~/.dsh/profiles/dsh-101/` and installs th"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ded: one-liner script** (places `profile/` into `~/.dsh/profiles/dsh-101/` and installs the bundle):"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"What the script does: places the three `profile/` files into `$DSH_HOME/profiles/dsh-101/`
(only fil"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ls in missing `dsh-base`/`dsh-web-app` layers if the profile already exists), primes the
DSH module "},{"id":"p17s3","text":"fallback (so in-box peers resolve at runtime), then runs `dsh plugin --profile dsh-101 add`
to insta"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"-box peers resolve at runtime), then runs `dsh plugin --profile dsh-101 add`
to install this bundle."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"**Manual install**:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Verify the bundles list has the three layers:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"> **Do NOT install into the `web` profile.** dsh-101's bundle disables `ui-layout`
> (the default br"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"owser shell); installed into any web-app profile it takes down the
> whole web (sidebar / conversati"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"on / app-shell all wait for the `layout` service and
> stay pending). Always use dsh-101 as its own "},{"id":"p22s4","text":"profile (`dsh --profile dsh-101`,
> default port 3081, coexists with the web GUI on 3080). `install."},{"id":"p22s5","text":"sh` now rejects
> `--profile web` outright."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### Port"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Defaults to 3081 (coexists with the web GUI on 3080). Two ways to change it:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"**At launch (recommended, no config change, dsh 0.1.0-rc.6+):**"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"**Persist a different default in the profile config:**"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"(Launch flags win; the patch value is only the fallback.)"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"> **Git installs ship build artifacts.** `lib/` is committed to this repository, so a git install
> "},{"id":"p30s2","text":"gets the built host + client bundles directly — **no build, no credentials needed**. If you install
"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"> from a pristine clone before building, run `node scripts/build.mjs` first (needs a DSH source chec"},{"id":"p30s4","text":" clone before building, run `node scripts/build.mjs` first (needs a DSH source checkout, see below)."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"### Upgrade"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Re-run the one-liner with the new pinned tag:"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"For a local-checkout installation, re-run `./scripts/install.sh .` against the updated checkout (it
"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"only fills in missing layers, so your profile state is preserved). When DSH itself publishes a new
s"},{"id":"p34s3","text":"napshot, sync the bundle sources from the upgraded checkout with `node scripts/upgrade.mjs`
(see "Up"},{"id":"p34s4","text":"grading from a newer DSH snapshot")."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"### Uninstall"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"The first command runs `pnpm remove` in the profile directory and removes the bundle from
`dsh.profi"},{"id":"p37s2","text":"le.bundles`; the second deletes the standalone profile itself."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"## Troubleshooting"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"| Symptom | Resolution |"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"| Web GUI (3080) is down / sidebar stays pending after installing dsh-101 | dsh-101 was installed in"},{"id":"p40s2","text":"to the `web` profile and disabled `ui-layout` — remove `@bill9109/dsh-101` from the web profile and "},{"id":"p40s3","text":"reinstall dsh-101 as its own profile with the one-liner |
| `dsh --profile dsh-101` fails to start |"},{"id":"p40s4","text":" Confirm `$DSH_HOME/profiles/dsh-101/` exists and its bundles list contains the three layers (`dsh-b"},{"id":"p40s5","text":"ase`, `dsh-web-app`, `@bill9109/dsh-101`); re-run `install.sh` if a layer is missing |
| Port 3081 a"},{"id":"p40s6","text":"lready in use | Pass `--port <port>` at launch, or persist a different default in the profile's `cor"},{"id":"p40s7","text":"dis.patch.yml` |
| GitHub install fails or installs stale code | Pin the install to a tag (`github:b"},{"id":"p40s8","text":"ill9109/dsh-101#v0.1.7`) or install from a local checkout (`./scripts/install.sh .`) |
| Documents m"},{"id":"p40s9","text":"issing or outdated | Regenerate the corpus from a DSH source checkout: `DSH_CHECKOUT=/path/to/dsh no"},{"id":"p40s10","text":"de scripts/build.mjs --corpus` |
| Broken after DSH published a new snapshot | Sync sources and rebu"},{"id":"p40s11","text":"ild with `node scripts/upgrade.mjs --checkout /path/to/upgraded-dsh` |"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"## Directory layout"},{"id":"p42s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p43s1","text":"## Build"},{"id":"p44s1","text":"The bundle's peer dependencies resolve from a DSH install — either a source checkout
(`DSH_CHECKOUT`"},{"id":"p44s2","text":") or the module fallback of a running DSH (`$DSH_HOME/profiles/node_modules`).
Toolchain binaries (t"},{"id":"p44s3","text":"sc, tsdown) prefer the DSH source checkout."},{"id":"p45s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p46s1","text":"`build.mjs` symlinks DSH's peers into `node_modules`, runs `tsc` (types into `types/`) then
`tsdown`"},{"id":"p46s2","text":" (host bundle + client bundle into `lib/`), and removes the symlinks afterwards."},{"id":"p47s1","text":"> **Usually no build needed.** `lib/` is committed; `dsh plugin add` (GitHub / tarball / local
> che"},{"id":"p47s2","text":"ckout) installs the built bundle. Build only when developing this repo or after an `upgrade` sync."}],"truncated":true}
